requirement_interpretation.exact_project_requirement: The required service/topic choice must be genuinely enforced on the WordPress target; source visible copy must not change.
requirement_interpretation.clarification: D05 requires functional enforcement but does not explicitly require server-side enforcement when MetForm's native Required control itself reliably blocks an empty user submission.
requirement_interpretation.consequence: Do not add a server validator merely because the generic PHP path does not independently prove an absent-radio rejection. First prove the actual Form33 radio setting and native behavior without a real submission.

native_metform_contract.frontend_effect: MetForm Radio maps mf_input_required=yes to required=true in its frontend validation configuration and renders the required-label marker.

server_path_observation.finding: The audited generic PHP validation path does not independently prove rejection of a completely absent required radio. This is a hardening concern, not by itself proof that the live target fails D05.
server_path_observation.supported_extension: mf_after_validation_check can reject submissions and is already used by project snippet ID5 for photo-count validation.

mandatory_next_live_read: Read the current Form33 #af-form-service radio widget only: exact widget ID/type, exact mf_input_name, exact mf_input_required, exact six option values/order.
Do not infer the field name from Miben kér segítséget? label text.
Do not edit shared Form33 as part of this page272-only package.

decision_tree_after_live_read.condition: mf_input_required != yes or required configuration is absent
decision_tree_after_live_read.next: Because Form33 is shared, do not change the shared widget setting from strict page272 scope. Prepare a page272-local enforcement solution only after current field ownership and current ID5/ID36 inventory are read.
Prove native empty-choice rejection with a non-delivery/non-entry validation path if available. Do not create PHP fallback merely to duplicate working native enforcement.

decision_tree_after_live_read.condition: native required is present but a safe non-delivery proof reproduces acceptance of an empty group
decision_tree_after_live_read.next: Use the existing-ID36 page272/Form33-scoped mf_after_validation_check fallback design after exact field/ID5 reads.

decision_tree_after_live_read.condition: native required is present and safe non-delivery proof rejects empty choice
decision_tree_after_live_read.next: No server fallback. Preserve native configuration and record proof only.

shared_form_constraint: MetForm33 is shared. No shared Form33 configuration mutation is authorized from page272-only scope merely to satisfy this page.
fallback_server_design_constraints: Existing ID36 only; no second default validator snippet.
Keep ID36 front-end scope; Code Snippets loads front-end PHP snippets on non-admin requests, including the non-admin MetForm REST path.
Strict Form33 insert route + wp_get_referer()->url_to_postid()==272 + exact live field-name guards.
No real form submission, entry creation, SMTP or external delivery test.
conclusion: The required-radio item is LIVE_READ_AND_NONDELIVERY_PROOF_FIRST, not an automatic server-PHP implementation. Server enforcement is a prepared fallback only if the live native Required path is absent or demonstrably insufficient.
